status: diagnostic follow-up informed by already published Experiment 1 results
checkpoint_selection: lowest validation group-balanced nonforced NLL over epochs 1..480, earliest exact tie; original best eligible
restart: restore original epoch-120 last.pt model, Adam, torch RNG and PCG64 shuffle state
primary_population: recorded current offers contain at least one offer >=1 at k=5
primary_effect: continued minus original recurrent energy score
endpoint: total retained resources within forecast window / (200*h)
energy_score: mean distance to observed endpoint minus off-diagonal pairwise distance sum/(2*M*(M-1)); no clipping
crps: univariate energy score with same off-diagonal finite-sample estimator
seed_aggregation: score each fitted seed separately then mean within human group
mechanism_aggregation: mean groups within mechanism then equally weight mechanisms; missing strata explicitly unavailable
main_first_allocation: recorded current allocation; preserve unallocated resource
numerical_sensitivity: canonical first allocation only; original and continued neural fits; k=5 h=10 eligible groups; paired first-bank seeds
future_allocation: canonical existing Equal/Mixed/Proportional using generated history and pool
termination: exact zero, absorbing zero padding; cumulative forecast-window surplus held constant
prefix: process observations 0..k-1 only; origin k observation processed once; no current/future targets enter input
display_default: first sorted Mixed test group, recurrent seed 17 continued, origin 5, branch index 0; all groups and failed forecasts accessible
reserved: Experiments 2-3 excluded; Experiment 4 deferred; no live M1 or Interpolating comparison
